hands-feet.summary: In the focal plane the hand gets the picture's most surface and sharpest edges: joint creases as valleys pointing to the knuckle, the nail as a glossy plate and cross-contour, straight light tendons and soft meandering veins; layer 1's construction underneath, a hierarchy of values and edges over it.

rules.rule: Put the picture's sharpest edges on the focal-plane hand only; everything else softens with its distance from that plane.
rules.source: Wikipedia, Depth of field: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depth_of_field; Wildlife Art Store, create depth: https://www.wildlifeartstore.com/create-depth-in-your-drawing/

rules.rule: Backs of fingers carry about 3 times the cheek's texture (mid band 5.3 vs 1.9 L*), concentrated in joint creases whose darks reach shadow values.
Creases follow the hand's action: distal joint a single straight crease, middle joint a spiral, creases pointing to the knuckle; others secondary and light.
Draw each crease as a valley with a lit lip, darkest inside the joint and fading at both ends.
rules.source: judgement; Wildlife Art Store, create depth: https://www.wildlifeartstore.com/create-depth-in-your-drawing/

rules.rule: The nail follows the finger's cylinder and is a cross-contour; add a specular along its curve, a lighter free edge and a soft cuticle overlap; the free edge is the hardest edge of the hand.
rules.source: Proko, details for realistic hands: https://www.proko.com/lesson/how-to-draw-hands-details-for-realistic-hands; judgement for the surface

rules.rule: Tendons straight and as light as the skin or lighter; veins meander in the hollows, slightly darker; neither outlined.
An extended thumb shows the anatomical snuffbox: two tendon ridges and a triangular hollow on the radial back of the wrist.
Create a hierarchy with values and edges; veins are tertiary; leave out what serves no purpose.
Plan crisp edges as reserved lights or masked (clip) blending; the engine cannot sharpen an edge afterwards.

keep: layer 1 palm block, knuckle arc, thumb from the wrist
perspective size from the camera distance
avoid: age spots and deep wrinkles on a 45-year-old hand
detail on parts outside the focal plane
flags: Nail surface rules are common observation, not a measured source (judgement).
The edge-width measure was too noisy with film grain to give a number for the hand's sharp edge.
